top_signals.title: Fortescue Says Risk to Full-Year Results On China Standoff
top_signals.summary: Iron ore miner Fortescue Ltd. said a standoff with state-backed buyer China Mineral Resources Group Co. may impact its full-year results, after quarterly shipments and sales prices fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: If Elon Musk gifts SpaceX stock through Trump Accounts, it will come with a catch
top_signals.summary: Elon Musk's planned SpaceX stock donation could come with strings attached if he uses Trump Accounts. New Treasury rules limit when shares can be sold.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
